_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-08-07 · SkyHero — Sierra now knows which college you're asking about, and points you to both your college and the student portal. Two decisions waiting on Sam.
_status: Sierra used to recommend a college fifty miles away when four were minutes down the road. The cause turned out not to be the distance ranking at all — she was never working out WHICH college you were asking about. The question 'Does Los Angeles Harbor College…' matched the word 'Angeles' against nine colleges, gave up, and never tried the word 'Harbor', which matches exactly one. Worse, the database was free to hand back any three of those nine, and did — two identical questions, two different answers. That is why she seemed unreliable in a way nobody could pin down: it was not the AI being vague, it was the lookup being random. Fixed, and she now offers a nearby college rather than a big distant one — a colleague reported this exact problem on 3 July and it sat unread in the feedback box for five weeks. Also new: a Copy button on every answer, and Sierra now tells people about BOTH their own college's CPL page AND Credit for Being You, explaining what each is for. Two things need your call: whether Sierra should point a student to a nearby college that teaches a subject (which colleges may not love), and the fact that nobody has ever read the feedback people have been leaving.

items.text: ⚖️ YOUR CALL — HOW FAR DO WE GO FOR THE STUDENT? You said err on the side of CPL seekers while supporting our colleges. The rule I wrote to stop Sierra 'poaching' students off a college's own page can backfire: told never to volunteer a comparison, she may stay quiet when someone asks about a certificate their college hasn't set up yet — which helps nobody. My proposed line: she never HIDES something that changes your outcome, but she never SELLS you on another college either. Say yes and I'll ship it.

🧭 YOUR CALL — WHAT SHOULD SIERRA SAY WHEN YOUR COLLEGE DOESN'T OFFER IT? Asked about NCCER carpentry at LA Harbor, she now names Norco and Barstow, the two colleges that have actually SET UP that credit, and suggests LA Harbor adopt it too. Our old automated test expects her to instead name nearby colleges that merely TEACH construction (El Camino, Trade Tech). No LA-area college has the credit set up. Both answers are defensible — which do you want? I won't quietly change the test to match the code.

📬 NOBODY HAS EVER READ THE FEEDBACK — 43 thumbs-up/down have come in since 1 July and not one has been marked reviewed. 10 are genuine thumbs-down with notes. One of them found today's bug, five weeks early. Before inviting the MAP and CO teams to test Sierra, worth draining these 10 once — otherwise a few hundred unread notes teach people their feedback goes nowhere.

🔗 CLICK THE LINK SIERRA NOW GIVES STUDENTS — creditforbeingyou.org/main/student. I could not open it from here (our sandbox blocks that site, nothing wrong with the site itself), so it is used exactly as you sent it. If students should land somewhere else, it is a one-line change.
📋 SIERRA ANSWERS NOW HAVE A COPY BUTTON — paste into Word, Outlook or Teams and the headings, tables and links come with it. Live on both the Sierra page and the dashboard tab.

🧹 FILTER THE TEST ROBOT OUT OF THE FEEDBACK QUEUE — 19 of the 43 feedback rows are our own automated test writing into the box humans are meant to read. Filter page='smoke' out of the review surface so the queue is worth opening.

🔍 FINISH THE POACHING AUDIT — a five-part review (Sierra's rule text, her per-audience voices, the section headings in her data, the live guidance rows in the database, and the college report generators) was still running when this session ended. It checks whether anything still steers a visitor away from the college hosting her.

📚 REFRESH SIERRA'S EXHIBIT LIST — unchanged and still the biggest limit. Her copy covers 2,397 exhibits across 59 colleges; MAP has 123, and her college profiles were last refreshed 25 June. American River, LA Mission and West LA all give CPR credit and she cannot see them. Touches a shared table production reads, so walk Sam through the impact first.

🔢 WIRE MALONE'S STUDENT×CREDIT-RECOMMENDATION VIEW into the funding backlog builder once the view name lands. The 11.8MB export could not be read directly (the Drive connector caps at 10MB). Agreed columns are the 8 non-identifying ones; Sam wants small-group suppression at fewer than 10.
